request: Could you drop me next to the trees on the left?
input: Original reviewed voice transcript was resubmitted directly to the normal public-photo model backend. No new audio transcription or passenger mark was used.
observation: The trees are on the left behind a raised curb. The pavement immediately alongside that curb is part of the through roadway; this view provides no clear off-lane bay there.
sample_scope: One reported UAE scene, reproduced as a regression. This cannot establish general landmark accuracy.
